Focus: Ranged combat, stealth, and survival.

Dattoumaru scouts are Kanigakure's forward eyes, trained to survive alone, move unseen, and report before a threat reaches the village.

Village: Kanigakure

Clan: Dattoumaru

Bonus Feat: Improved Initiative

Starting Techniques:

  • Ninpou: Shurikenjutsu - Renken
  • Kenjutsu: Kudari-uchi
  • Kakureimino no Jutsu
